Subject: Consolidated debrief + recommendation — Sanjay Iyer (Platform ML)

Thanks everyone for quick turns — consolidating here so recruiting and Priya (hiring mgr) have a single place to act.

Summary of submitted scores: (avg shown)
- Competence: 3.67 (Jonas 4 / Soojin 3 / Tessa 4)
- Ownership: 3.67 (4 / 3 / 4)
- Communication: 3.33 (3 / 4 / 3)
- Role fit: 3.67 (4 / 3 / 4)

Panel split: Jonas -> hire with reservation; Soojin -> no hire; Tessa -> hire with reservation.

My read: Sanjay shows solid systems instincts and is articulate about tradeoffs; gaps are pragmatic and centered on recent, hands-on ownership of compiler/kernel constraints and mature SLO degradation plans. He could likely ramp into the role but would require a 6–12 week onboarding focus with a clear mentor and a small initial project that touches our kernel/quantization work.

Recommendation: move to a follow-up deep-dive loop with a 45–60m infra check (pairing with Soojin). If the candidate can demonstrate concrete approaches and a short write-up on cache invalidation/testing, we proceed to offer; otherwise, do not proceed.

Action items:
- Marissa: schedule a focused deep-dive with Soojin (45–60m) — target this week if possible.
- Priya: confirm whether the hiring bar can accept conditional ramp plan.
- Jonas & Soojin: if you have a 3–5 bullet checklist for the deep-dive please paste here (helps standardize evaluation).
- I’ll attach a consolidated scorecard and send to Priya once we have Soojin’s availability.

Attachment: Sanjay_Iyer_consolidated-scorecard.pdf
Link to consolidated doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-sanjay-debrief

If there are objections to the path above, please reply-all by 2026-10-02T12:00:00-07:00. Absent objections, Marissa will book the loop and we’ll aim to close by end-of-week.

Thanks — Tessa
